content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Central University of Jammu Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment drive is being conducted by the Central University of Jammu for empanelment of Guest Faculty positions for the academic session 2026-27 in Samba, Jammu and Kashmir.

faq.question: Q2. What are the total vacancies available under this notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the post of Guest Faculty distributed across Community College (B.Voc) in Banking and Financial Services and English departments.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for Central University of Jammu Recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly Walk-in. Eligible candidates directly report for the interview along with their required documents and application form on the scheduled date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the walk-in interview date for these posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to take place on 08 October 2026. Candidates must ensure they report to the venue on time along with all necessary paperwork.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for Guest Faculty in English?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Guest Faculty position in English must possess a Postgraduate degree in English or meet the qualifications specified as per UGC guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for Community College (B.Voc) Banking and Financial Services?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Guest Faculty position in Community College (B.Voc) specialising in Banking and Financial Services must hold an MBA and Allied Subjects degree.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Guest Faculty posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 1,500/- per lecture, up to a maximum ceiling limit of Rs. 50,000/- per calendar month.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for attending the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Yes, General and OBC candidates are required to pay an application processing fee of Rs. 500/- via Demand Draft, whereas SC, ST, and PwBD candidates are fully exempted.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry to the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry original documents, experience certificates, one photocopy set of self-attested documents, a detailed CV or Bio-data, two passport-size photographs, and a filled application form.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification details and updates?
faq.answer: You can review the complete advertisement and download the official notification PDF by visiting the Important Links section provided in this recruitment article.
